action.objective: Capture the e5 pawn with check to disrupt Black's king and win material.
action.rationale: d3e5 is the only commit-ready move. It captures the e5 pawn with check (Nxe5+), forcing Black's king to move (f7g7), then Ng6 wins the bishop pair or damages pawn structure. Verified at depth 4 with exact score 181 and safety not_found for checking-reply mates. Black queen on d2 attacks e2 bishop but Nxe5+ seizes the initiative and wins a pawn.
